relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin (10 µM), a TRPV1 agonist which can initiate activity in nociceptive neurons

relationships.subject: Capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: both supra- and subthreshold voltage events can be blocked by an antagonist capsazepine

relationships.subject: Peripheral inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: peripheral inflammation or nerve injury caused profound changes in subthreshold voltage activity in more than half of all recording neurons

key_findings: Pirt-Marina knock-in mice report in vivo voltage dynamics of DRG and TG neurons; high-frequency firing encodes pain while subthreshold/low-frequency activity encodes itch.
Inflammation and nerve injury induce spontaneous, synchronized DRG activity (blocked by carbenoxolone) and sensitize responses to mechanical, thermal and capsaicin stimuli.
